name: Mollet del Vallès (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes, the upper half white with a red mullet fish of the arms in the upper hoist, then a red stripe and a white stripe.
history: The flag was approved on 8 August 1990 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 1338 of 3 September 1990; it is an oblong flag of 2:3 divided horizontally into three stripes, the first, of half the height, white with the red mullet of the arms in the corner, followed by a red and a white stripe.

features.role: red mullet (moll) of the arms in the upper hoist corner
